page.overview:
Who is Girrin Ancero?

Girrin Ancero was a male pilot of the Royal Naboo Security Forces who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Dialogue pertaining to Girrin Ancero appeared in the directory tree files for the 2003 massively multiplayer online roleplaying game Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided. However, he never actually appeared on the video game's live servers as a proper non-player character.
